title: MASH: A Multiplatform and Multimodal Annotated Dataset for Societal Impact of Hurricane

bias_targets.methodology: Annotating multimodal social media posts using a collaborative human-MLLM framework (Gemini-2.0-flash) and evaluating the performance of baseline models (RoBERTa, BART, ConvBERT, ELECTRA) on detecting biased, inappropriate, or offensive language.
